About

LinkedIn

I was born in Ankara and grew up near a wonderful university, Middle East Technical University. It was there that I became interested in robotics and started a robotics team with my friends.

I moved to the UK to study engineering at the University of Cambridge, where I specialised in computer engineering. Along the way, I was introduced to molecular biology—the hardest module I have ever taken.

I started Neuromorphic, my YC company, with the aim of revolutionising laboratories. We’re building on the new wave of robotics to automate wet labs and, ultimately, scientific discovery itself.
